# Overview

Early experimenting with the KPI project and Duckdb.

# Load Packages

```{r}
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb("db/faculty.duckdb"))
```

```{r}
# Data checks
dbGetQuery(con, "SHOW TABLES;")
```

# Using v_current_faculty in R

Example: list current faculty by unit and rank:

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb("db/faculty.duckdb"))

current <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT unit_code, rank, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM v_current_faculty
  GROUP BY unit_code, rank
  ORDER BY unit_code, rank;
")

dbDisconnect(con)
current
```

Example: simple roster view:

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb("db/faculty.duckdb"))

roster <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT first_name, last_name, email, unit_code, rank, track, fte_share
  FROM v_current_faculty
  ORDER BY unit_code, last_name, first_name;
")

dbDisconnect(con)
roster
```
